Permission.title: Permission
Permission.description: The atomic unit of authority: capability + resource + action.

Policy.title: Policy
Policy.description:
Organisational rule evaluated after authority has been established.

Policies never create authority; they constrain how existing authority
may be used. Empty match lists mean "any". Resource patterns accept
shell-style wildcards (``file:///hr/*``).

PolicyConditions.title: PolicyConditions
PolicyConditions.description: Constraints that must hold for an ALLOW / REQUIRE_APPROVAL policy to apply.

Principal.title: Principal
Principal.description:
A human user or an AI agent known to TrustGraph.

Identity is deliberately separate from authorisation: a registered,
active agent holds *technical capabilities* (the tools it can drive)
but no authority until grants or delegations give it some.

RequestContext.title: RequestContext
RequestContext.description:
Runtime context supplied with a request.

``untrusted_input`` is set by the agent runtime once the agent has
ingested content it does not control (web pages, files, tool output),
which is the precondition for indirect prompt injection.

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: A protected resource identified by a canonical URI.
